task.description: Validate src/design/iss203_idempotency_keys.md for ISS-203. Hard gate - BACKEND-DEV cannot start until PASS.
acceptance_criteria: Every ISS-203 acceptance criterion has a corresponding design element
Hash function choice documented with rationale
ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING path described
Function signatures implied are unambiguous enough for BACKEND-DEV

result.summary: Design artefact src/design/iss203_idempotency_keys.md passes all hard-gate checks. All seven acceptance criteria are satisfied: (1) Hash key composition covers all five required fields (instance_id, triggering_event_seq, node_id, emitted_event_type, ordinal) with sentinel-byte separation; (2) Replay determinism is stated as Invariant R-1 with four proofs; (3) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING deduplication path in store.zig is described in Section 4 with is_duplicate=true semantics; (4) Client-supplied trigger keys are structurally excluded (Section 5, Invariant K-4); (5) FNV-1a hash choice is documented with explicit rationale vs BLAKE3/SHA-256; (6) No implementation code present — only type declarations and signatures; (7) All public function signatures (transition(), TransitionResult, EmittedEvent, computeEmittedEventKey, InvalidTriggeringSeq) are unambiguous enough for BACKEND-DEV. Lint tool reports 0 issues.
